problem.title: Python can't find function from imported module - first time creating an __init__.py file
problem.description: In main.py I have this line: from core import * . There is a subfolder called core and in that folder I created a bunch of modules to organize my functions. One is called fileManagement.py . It has a couple functions in it including importInputs() . I also created an __init__.py file in the core folder with __all__ = ["fileManagement"] . Main.py includes this line: df=importInputs() . All of this worked when everything was in one .py file, but now I get NameError: name 'importInputs' is not defi
